result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 source shows UpdateTaskParams has only meta, task_id and input_responses; CancelTaskParams has only meta and task_id. There is no stock generation/fence field. RequestMetaObject preserves arbitrary extension keys, but incoming wire params._meta is canonicalized into envelope extensions and then RequestContext.meta while typed params meta stays empty. Therefore the smallest stock-compatible fence carrier is a namespaced custom RequestContext.meta key, parsed fail-closed and bound to task_id plus server-authenticated principal before any persistent generation-CAS mutation.
